name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A set of ready-made habits and checklists that push an AI coding assistant to act like a disciplined senior engineer instead of guessing.

A dev-tools educator sells a paid course or community that extends these skills with company-specific playbooks.
A code-quality consultancy runs a one-time 'install discipline into your AI workflow' engagement for teams drowning in AI-generated tech debt.

money_ideas.idea: Paid community/newsletter built around maintaining and extending the skills
Flat-fee 'install and customize these skills for your repo' engagement

steal_this: Offer a handful of startups a one-time 'AI coding hygiene setup' this weekend: install and tune skill packs like this across their repo for a flat fee.
